name: @textfilters/profanity
description: Profanity filtering primitives for composable text moderation.

scripts.lint: prettier README.md docs package.json src tests --check
scripts.format: prettier README.md docs package.json src tests --write
scripts.smoke:dist: npm run build && tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --target ES2024 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --skipLibCheck tests/dist-public-api-smoke.ts && node tests/dist-public-api-smoke.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run smoke:dist && npm run pack:dry-run
